newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's UDI bonds real return 7.76 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's UDI bonds real return 7.76 pct.

text.p: Mexico's UDI bonds were assigned at a price of 100.61325 UDIs and a real return of 7.76 percent at the primary auction on Tuesday.
Two weeks ago the UDI bonds had a real return of 7.96 percent.
Demand this week was 877.58 million UDIs compared to 150 million UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico with a bid-to-cover ratio of 5.85.
Two weeks ago demand was 923.1 million UDIs with a bid-to-cover ratio of 6.15.
